title: Implement the wait-only adaptive backpressure axis
summary: Implement REQ-QUIC-CRT-0191 as a closed legacy_current and early_delay application-admission seam with force, observe-only, shadow, safety fallback, unified evidence, exact raw joins, and force-legacy rollback while measurement and active behavior remain frozen.
planned_changes: Add the closed policy enums and deterministic evaluator; add one-time application-admission latching and one immediately posted continuation; propagate internal listener and connection options; keep disabled, observe-only, shadow, forced-legacy, and forced-early-delay identities distinct; keep safety guards authoritative; add bounded operation and epoch evidence; extend unified evidence/raw to v8 and its export manifest to v9; preserve sample-scoped admission records in a separate append-only stream with exact source, connection, and operation-sequence joins; add deterministic mechanism, fallback, adjacent-axis, cancellation, schema, semantic-validator, and rollback tests; and synchronize the matrix, seam, observation, controller, Stage 2, schema, and evidence documents.
verification_plan: Build the narrow affected projects in Release. Run REQ-QUIC-CRT-0191 and the unified REQ-QUIC-CRT-0183 home. Verify every forced value, shadow non-application, exactly one delayed turn, no-backlog behavior, force-legacy rollback, lifecycle and continuation guards, missing, stale, saturated, contradictory, invalid, and out-of-domain fallback, cancellation after posting, invalid configuration, adjacent-axis rejection, configured empty epochs, schemas, exact sample-to-epoch joins, aggregate recomputation, and raw manifest counts. Run focused application-send queue, flow-control, cancellation, disposal, terminal, and ownership homes. Do not run performance, campaigns, transforms, ML, CI, or active behavior.
out_of_scope: Rejection, synchronous failure, or a public backpressure API
Waiting for ACK, credit, peer, network, congestion, pacing, socket, or recovery progress
Raising or replacing hard queue, buffer, stream, flow-control, packet, congestion, pacing, recovery, or ownership limits
Campaign, dataset, normalization, curation, split, or ML execution
CI changes, push, active_internal, or production activation
